scenes.text: Before the whole forest, Ash and his family confessed. Ember showed everyone how the lantern failed and the warning was ignored.
I cannot undo our mistake. But I can help rebuild every bridge and every home we lost.
We were never going to heal by blaming the wrong animal. We heal when we finally listen.
They rebuilt together. At sunrise the forest was bright again, and the little fox had a home. The end.
